title: Simple Present Passive
description: Learn to form passive voice with is/are + past participle

explain.ta: Passive voice-ல் நாம் செயலை செய்பவரை விட செயலையே முக்கியமாக காட்டுகிறோம். Simple present passive-ஐ உருவாக்க: is/are + past participle பயன்படுத்துகிறோம். Active: 'The author writes the book' → Passive: 'The book is written by the author'. Passive voice-ஐ பயன்படுத்தும்போது செயலை செய்பவர் தெரியாமல் இருக்கலாம் அல்லது முக்கியமில்லாமல் இருக்கலாம். இது formal writing மற்றும் scientific reports-ல் அதிகம் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது.
explain.en: In passive voice, we focus on the action rather than who does it. To form simple present passive: use is/are + past participle. Active: 'The author writes the book' → Passive: 'The book is written by the author'. We use passive voice when the doer is unknown, unimportant, or obvious. It's commonly used in formal writing, news reports, and scientific descriptions to maintain objectivity.

examples: The door is closed at 6 PM.
The doors are closed at 6 PM.

examples.en: The book is written by a famous author.
English is spoken in many countries.
The office is cleaned every day.
These cars are made in Japan.
The news is broadcast at 9 PM.
Rice is grown in many Asian countries.
This language is taught in schools.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The house is painted every year.
options: The house is painted every year.
The house was painted every year.

listeningQuestions.audioText: These phones are designed in California.
options: These phones are designed in California.
These phones were designed in California.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The report is prepared by the team.
options: The report prepares by the team.
The report was prepared by the team.
The report is prepared by the team.

speakSentences.en: The newspaper is delivered every morning.
These shoes are made of leather.
The meeting is held on Mondays.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: They speak Spanish here. Passive: Spanish ___ here.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர்கள் இங்கே ஸ்பானிஷ் பேசுகிறார்கள். Passive: ஸ்பானிஷ் இங்கே ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: The company produces cars. Passive: Cars ___ by the company.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: நிறுவனம் கார்களை உற்பத்தி செய்கிறது. Passive: கார்கள் நிறுவனத்தால் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: She writes the letter. Passive: The letter ___ by her.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவள் கடிதம் எழுதுகிறாள். Passive: கடிதம் அவளால் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: They teach English. Passive: English ___ by them.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர்கள் ஆங்கிலம் கற்பிக்கிறார்கள். Passive: ஆங்கிலம் அவர்களால் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: People use this app. Passive: This app ___ by people.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: மக்கள் இந்த ஆப்பை பயன்படுத்துகிறார்கள். Passive: இந்த ஆப் மக்களால் ___.

masteryQuestions.promptEn: This song ___ by millions of people.
